summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature in rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ReaderContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file), added 14 tests to tests/test_progress.py, a Reading-from-a-file section in docs/source/progress.rst, and one Unreleased/Added entry in CHANGELOG.md. The diff is additive (911 insertions, 0 deletions) and nothing was committed. Nothing was executed, so tests, black, and mypy are unverified. Open risks: on Python 3.6, typing.IO's abstract mode/name properties may block instantiation of the reader; the changelog entry has no PR link; a failed open in Progress.open leaves an orphan task, following the spec's ordering.
